default.notes: Consular tourist visa required, applied for at a Uruguayan embassy or consulate before travel.

groups.notes: Visa-free under Mercosur/associate arrangements — nationals can enter with just their national ID card (no passport needed) and stay up to 90 days; one 90-day extension (prórroga) can be requested from the Dirección Nacional de Migración.
Visa-free for tourism up to 90 days; one 90-day extension (prórroga) can be requested from the Dirección Nacional de Migración before the stay expires.
Commonly listed among Uruguay's visa-exempt nationalities for short tourist stays, but the list is amended from time to time — confirm with a Uruguayan consulate before booking.

UY.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Uruguayan citizens.

VE.notes: Venezuelan citizens enter visa-free for up to 90 days on a valid passport. Venezuela's Mercosur membership is suspended, so the ID-card route is not reliable — travel on a passport.

CN.notes: A visa is required for ordinary Chinese passports; group tourism arrangements and holders of valid US or Schengen visas are sometimes treated more generously — confirm with the Uruguayan consulate before booking.
